svg.title: Mind Map Studio — feature tour
svg.desc: An animated walkthrough of Mind Map Studio: Feature tour: An offline-first mind map and brainstorming app that runs in your browser.; 1 · Start a project: Create a project, open the bilingual guide, or drop any file to import it.; 2 · Build your map from the keyboard: Tab adds a child, Enter adds a sibling, F2 renames. Drag nodes to move or re-parent them.; 3 · Navigate and fold: Arrow keys follow the sides of the map. Space folds a branch; Alt+, collapses all, Alt+. expands, Alt+1…3 show levels.; 4 · Brainstorm in an outliner: Type an idea, Enter for the next one, Tab to nest it — even while typing. Copy to map turns bullets into a map.; 5 · Outline and split view: The Outline view shows the map as an indented list (with the same folding). Split view puts two views side by side.; 6 · Notes, roles and the details panel: Every node has Markdown notes, a role (theme, task, risk, question…) and a side. Ctrl+I shows or hides the panel.; 7 · Tasks with progress: Make any node a task; Ctrl+Enter ticks it. Done tasks are struck through and the parent shows progress.; 8 · Colours, emoji and labelled links: Give a node a colour from the theme and an emoji. Link any two nodes and name the link.; 9 · Tags and filters: End a title with #tags while renaming. The Tags filter dims or hides everything else; search understands #tag too.; 10 · Pictures on nodes: Paste a screenshot (Ctrl+V) or drop a picture onto a node. Click the thumbnail to see it full size.; 11 · Focus on one branch: Alt+→ shows a single branch as if it were the whole map; the breadcrumb climbs back out. Export just that branch.; 12 · Find anything, do anything: Ctrl+F searches every node — even folded or off-screen ones. Ctrl+K opens a palette with every command.; 13 · Present your map: F5 walks through the map full screen, one step at a time. Arrows or Space go on, B blanks the screen, Esc leaves.; 14 · Safe with your data: Everything autosaves to your browser. Undo survives a reload; snapshots, a 30-day Trash and one-file backups protect the rest.; 15 · Sync between computers: Link a OneDrive folder in Chrome or Edge: each project is a file there. Conflicts keep both versions; nothing is deleted outright.; 16 · Work with any AI assistant: Export for AI hands your assistant a JSON file (expand, convert or improve); import its reply back as one undo step.; 17 · Share, print and install: Export Markdown, OPML, FreeMind, PNG, SVG or an interactive HTML page; Ctrl+P prints. Install it as an app to work offline.; Get started: Open the app and choose “Try the guide · 入门指南” — a map that teaches the shortcuts by using them.

Search “#p1 pricing” finds tagged nodes that mention pricing.
Zoom with the wheel · 0 fits · add a description · Esc closes
Every change is saved in this browser
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y — even after a reload
Whole library (with images) as one ZIP
GitHub milestones: save a version to a private repo ⤴

Chrome / Edge: install icon in the address bar · Android: Install app · iPhone: Add to Home Screen
Free and open source (MIT). Your projects never leave your device.
